recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-13721. Do not re-add label/code checks unless a later tracker reverses FHIR-48326; future sdf-9 scope changes should be handled under their own issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13721 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested correcting invalid sdf-9 FHIRPath expressions because the first differential element is not guaranteed to be the root when an unconstrained differential omits the root element.
initial_application: Jira records the application as svn revision 12783. The available Git history has no FHIR-13721-tagged commit, but the imported source already contains the requested root-path selector by 129c9fa6f5, and StructureDefinition is actively built from source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml via source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: FHIR-48326 later narrowed sdf-9 for R6 by removing label and code and retaining only requirements, with implementation commit 7775de0901 preserving the FHIR-13721 root selector. FHIR-15803 corrected the same invariant's grammar, and FHIR-8839 is older sdf-9 background.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current sdf-9 source uses children().element.where(path.contains('.').not()).requirements.empty(), so the first-element FHIRPath defect is already absent.
